title: メディア情報学入門とキャリアデザイン
subtitle: Introduction to Media Informatics and Career Design
educationalGoal: In this course, students will gain a systematic understanding of this university's departmental education and research, acquire learning objectives, and develop planning skills.
advice:
In this course, students will gain an understanding media informatics via lectures from faculty members and specialists in the fields of Media Informatics. The topics covered will include understanding the relationship between the field and society.

In the introduction of education and research fields, students will acquire an understanding of the contents of learning in the media technology and media design fields, and will also learn about the research efforts in those fields through specific examples.

Students will participate in exercises based on the knowledge acquired through this course. Each student will make individualized learning goals and study plans for their four-year course of study.
requiredKnowledge: Experience of using digital media or a computer.

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand the studies of Media Informatics and the relationship between the field and society.
Be able to write reports based on the lectures taken.
Be able to understand the learning fields and research projects of Media Informatics.
Be able to create learning goals and a study plan for a four-year study.
